thread:
Alex: Heads-up — proposing a small experiment for rollout telemetry and deterministic eval snapshots for feature flags. want to avoid noisy signal when we flip slices across regions.
Maria: +1. can you sketch gating + sampling?
Alex: high level: two pieces — 1) toggle telemetry sampling (per-tenant deterministic shard) 2) periodic eval snapshots tied to the flag seed so we can reproduce outputs later. short checklist in-thread.
Samir: sounds good. important: ensure snapshots don't include PII, and store only prompts + anonymized outputs/meta.
Alex: agreed. privacy rules: strip user ids, truncate long context, store only seed + model version + prompt-hash + output-hash + metrics.
Jess: what metrics do we need to gate on? my thoughts: latency_p95, error_rate, hallucination_rate (from eval harness), quality_regressions (human-labeled sample).
Maria: also token-cost-per-request for cost gating. include traffic fraction and trend slope over 30m.
Alex: proposed flag config prototype (for ops to copy):
```
flag: rollout_toggle_v2
sampling: 0.01    # 1% initial
seed: tenant_id_hash
buckets: [control, variant]
metrics:
  - latency_p95
  - error_rate
  - quality_score
gates:
  - latency_p95 < 250ms for 15m
  - error_rate < 0.75% for 15m
  - delta(quality_score) >= -0.02 (no big drop)
rollback_triggers:
  - sustained breach > 10m
  - customer complaint spike > 3x baseline
```
Samir: love deterministic seed approach — reproducibility for evals is huge. a couple notes: tenant_id_hash must be salted per-environment. and we should allow "manual shard pin" for customer opt-ins.
Maria: for A/B evaluation snapshots: snapshot window every 5m for 1h after rollout increment. store sample of 200 prompts per snapshot with anonymized outputs. we run auto-evals + send to human review for any regressions flagged by the eval harness.
Jess: ops question — where do snapshots live and retention? we should TTL snapshots to 90 days by default, with enterprise option for longer. also ensure snapshot export to S3 with KMS.
Alex: default: internal telemetry store (short-term) + archived export to customer S3 for enterprise. retention: 90 days internal, 365 configurable export. encryption-at-rest + access logs.
Maria: launch criteria proposal:
- Preflight: smoke run on canary region at 0.1% for 60m, pass all gates
- Gradual: 0.1 -> 1 -> 5 -> 25 -> 100 (per region) with 30-60m observation windows
- Must-have: zero untriaged SLO breaches, no sustained quality regression, cost delta within predicted band
Samir: add a hard stop — if any household customer in the trial reports data loss or privacy concern, freeze and rollback.
Jess: who owns the human review queue? product supports, but need 1-2 on-call raters during canary windows. ops-bot can page them.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary started in eu-west-1 at 2024-06-18T14:20Z, slice=0.1%
Alex: nice. final ask: product to own snapshot schema and eval criteria, eng to implement deterministic seeding + telemetry sampler, ops to wire retention/export and pages. can we commit owners?
Maria: product (Maria) owns schema & eval criteria.
Samir: eng (Samir) owns seeding impl and privacy sanitization.
Jess: ops (Jess) owns retention/export & on-call rater runway.
Alex: timeline request: prototype in 2 weeks, internal canary the week after. any blockers?
Samir: dependency: small change in runtime to expose tenant_id_hash before truncation. i'll queue a PR.
Maria: ok, i'll draft a short launch checklist and attach sample queries for the eval harness.
Jess: I'll set up ops-bot alerts and a private channel for human review.
Alex: perfect — thanks all. will post a one-pager with checklist + minimal config by EOD. :thumbsup:
summary: Thread: plan for deterministic rollout telemetry + eval snapshots, gating metrics and launch criteria, owners and timeline
